name: Animate My Site
author: edobegagic

sections.description:
Animate My Site lets you add subtle or bold animations to your content, with the ability to disable animations per block or per page.
The plugin is built for the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg). Per-block disable controls are available for supported Gutenberg blocks. Animations target standard HTML elements, so content created with other block plugins may also be animated, but per-block disable controls are not available.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin
  2. Activate it
  3. Go to Animate My Site → Settings
